gates.summary: golangci-lint version and repo-wide lint are pinned
all Go packages run in the baseline gate
baseline CI publishes this executable evidence

loop.observation: The broad Go CI workflow was the final non-live workflow that executed important checks without durable JSON evidence.
loop.hypothesis: A compact baseline manifest can make lint, full-test, tool-version, and evidence publication expectations explicit without duplicating domain-specific gates.
loop.execute: Verify go-ci.yml against this manifest, generate the reader, and publish go-ci-baseline-evidence from the workflow.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails when go-ci drops the Go version pin, module download, lint command, full test, or evidence artifact upload.
loop.retrospective: This keeps broad CI as a safety net while making its observable contract machine-checkable.
